questions.question: In my family, both my parents work, so they always _______ the household chores.
questions.explanation: 'Split the household chores' means to share household chores equally between family members.

questions.question: My father is the _______ in the house. He works hard to earn money for our family.
questions.explanation: 'Breadwinner' is the person who earns money to support their family.

questions.question: Look at the dark clouds! It _______ rain soon.
questions.explanation: We use 'be going to' for predictions based on present evidence (dark clouds).

questions.question: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently: /br/ vs /kr/
questions.explanation: 'crash' starts with /kr/, while bread, breakfast, and brother start with /br/.

questions.question: We should adopt a _______ lifestyle to protect the environment for future generations.
questions.explanation: Green, sustainable, and eco-friendly lifestyles all refer to protecting the environment.

questions.question: Turning off electrical appliances when not in use helps reduce our carbon _______.
questions.explanation: 'Carbon footprint' is the amount of greenhouse gases produced by our activities.

questions.question: Single-use plastic items take hundreds of years to _______ in the environment.
questions.explanation: 'Decompose' means to decay or break down naturally.

questions.question: The passive form of 'People throw away plastic bags every day' is:
options: Plastic bags are thrown away every day.
Plastic bags were thrown away every day.
Plastic bags are being thrown away every day.
Plastic bags have been thrown away every day.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: S + am/is/are + V3/ed.
